dorsal_planar_contour_and_symmetry.axial_tapering: Symmetrical narrowing beginning at the mid-section and tapering linearly toward a pointed posterior peduncle.
dorsal_planar_contour_and_symmetry.planar_edge_undulation: None; lateral margins are smooth and exhibit high bilateral symmetry.

surface_reflectance_and_textural_phase.global_grayscale_baseline: Dark slate-grey pigmentation consistent with juvenile dorsal surface.
surface_reflectance_and_textural_phase.mottling_density_and_topology: Low spatial frequency of dark clusters; dominated by elongated vertical dark-pixel streaks on the posterior half.
surface_reflectance_and_textural_phase.transition_boundaries: Diffuse; soft gradient transitions between the baseline grey and the darker posterior markings.

high_frequency_epidermal_anomalies.localized_point_contrast_disruptions: Multiple dark vertical linear marks (rake-like patterns) concentrated on the posterior dorsal plane.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Presence of multiple vertical dark linear scars or rake marks on the posterior dorsal area.
other_distinctive_markers: Dark circular blowhole aperture clearly visible at the anterior-most point of the dorsal surface.
